articles.title: Saturn's Moon Shoots Out Ice Grains That Don't Match Its Ocean
articles.summary: A spacecraft caught ice grains blasting from Saturn's moon Enceladus. The grains had wildly different salts — but they all came from the same ocean. Scientists just figured out why.

articles.title: These Galápagos Sea Turtles Didn't Wander — They Stayed Home
articles.summary: Sea turtles are famous for epic ocean journeys. But nine tagged green sea turtles in the Galápagos barely left the neighborhood for up to 418 days. Scientists were surprised.

articles.title: New Iron Minerals Could Hold Water From Earth's Birth
articles.summary: Scientists squished minerals between tiny diamonds and found two new iron minerals that can store water deep inside Earth. They might be a missing link in how our planet got its oceans.
